item.title: Phase 3 Pembrolizumab Shows PFS Benefit in Cutaneous Melanoma
item.description: Pembrolizumab demonstrated 12.3-month median PFS in cutaneous melanoma. NCT12345678 met its primary endpoint with ORR of 68%.

item.title: Avelumab Approved for Merkel Cell Carcinoma
item.description: FDA approval for avelumab in Merkel cell carcinoma based on JAVELIN trial.

item.title: Lung Cancer Immunotherapy Shows OS Benefit
item.description: Atezolizumab in NSCLC extends overall survival in phase 3 trial.
